maya: Morning team — infra cooled overnight but we still saw a noisy perf outlier in staging. Need a minimal cut for MVP launch this Fri. My proposal: ship core chat, embeddings, and short-term convo history (7d). Defer admin analytics, real-time dashboards, tenant routing (unless we can gate it), and long-term export. Thoughts?

diego: Sounds reasonable. Quick question: can we keep tenant routing behind a feature flag so we can pilot for a few customers? It touches auth but could be gated.

chun: Infra notes: tenant routing adds memory pressure and extra KV lookups — roughly +20% memory at p95. If we keep it we likely need one additional gateway node during peak. For risk control, we should have a scripted toggle to disable routing in <15m.

hana: Support request: if dashboards are cut, we need a read-only debug endpoint and tenant->trace mapping so SRE/support can triage customer issues. That can be feature-flagged and low effort.

lucy: +1 from support. Without dashboards we need an exportable traces view scoped to tenant IDs. Low overhead if we expose read-only queries.

maya: Decision guardrails proposal: run canary for 12h. If canary p95 < 180ms we go with the "soft path" (tenant routing behind feature-flag and pilot enabled for up to 3 customers). If p95 >= 180ms we do the "hard cut" (remove tenant routing and dashboards from the initial release, defer to v1). Sales exceptions allowed for up to 3 named tenants with exec sign-off.

diego: I'll prepare both PRs: (A) soft-flag route with safe-defaults + fallback to single-tenant path, and (B) hard-cut branch that strips routing & dashboards. ETA: 8 hours for drafts.

chun: I'll author the rollback runbook: disable flag -> restart gateway -> verify health checks -> run smoke tests. Target rollback < 15 minutes. I'll add an automated alert if memory climbs above threshold.

hana: I'll draft customer-facing comms and handbook updates explaining deferred features, expected v1 timeline, and pilot program details. Also will add a post-launch sprint to recover deferred items.

deploy-bot: release plan updated: branch release/2026-05-20 -> staging at 2026-05-18 03:00 UTC :shipit:

maya: Action items recap: 1) @diego open PRs for soft-flag + hard-cut (ETA 8h), 2) @chun create rollback script and alerts, 3) @hana update comms + handbook, 4) @lucy prep support playbook. I'll tentatively lock scope to core chat + embeddings + 7d history, tenant routing = feature-flag soft path conditional on canary. Final lock at 17:00 unless objections.

lucy: I'll map observability metrics to tenant IDs and write the support runbook.

diego: PRs opened: github.com/redwood/release/pull/799 (soft-flag), github.com/redwood/release/pull/800 (hard-cut). Tests passing, notes in PR for QA.

maya: Thanks all — locking scope now pending canary. I'll post the final scope note to the handbook after the 12h canary window.
